name: CRM App - Customer List & Drawer
summary: Demo CRM screen: a customer list with filter, layout and sort controls plus a detail drawer showing one customer's profile and metrics.
description: A single-screen CRM UI built around a customer table and a detail drawer. The list view carries filter, layout, sort and view-settings controls; the drawer opens a customer record (Vertex Financial Services) with company facts, account details and KPI tiles — response rate 92%, email exchange rate 1,198, NPS 75, retention rate 85%. The workspace sidebar covers company, customers, transactions, workflows, payments, billing and reporting.
contains: customer list with filter, layout, sort and view settings
detail drawer for a single customer record
KPI tiles: response rate 92%, NPS 75, retention rate 85%
app sidebar: customers, transactions, workflows, payments, billing, reporting
